}}'''Jaim Adarra''' is the captain of the ''[[Snow Goose]]''.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Jaim Adarra}}

==Activities==
After [[Perrin]] helped [[Gaul]] escape and kill some Whitecloaks, he, [[Loial]], [[Moiraine]] and [[Lan]] needed a hasty departure from [[Remen]]. They pay Jaim Adarra to leave earlier than planned to sail to [[Illian]] down the [[River Manetherendrelle]]. Just after the ''Snow Goose'' casts off, [[Faile]] jumps aboard.{{ref/book|3|35}}. They depart the ship in Illian.{{ref/book|3|41}}
